snippet.title: Hide The Corpse - Official PS VR2 Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: See some of the ridiculous ways you can stash a body in this new Hide The Corpse trailer for the VR physics-based puzzle game. Hide The Corpse will be available on PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2) on August 18, 2025. It is already available on Meta Quest, and coming to PC.
